issues.explanation: Chapter 56 already states that Zhou Yu’s reopened wound causes him to fall from his horse. Chapter 57 then says hearing that Liu Bei and Kongming are drinking makes him fall again, incorrectly repeating and causally relocating the same event.
issues.suggested_fix: Begin Chapter 57 with Zhou Yu being rescued back to the ship, then report that he hears Liu Bei and Kongming are drinking on the mountaintop and becomes enraged.
